title: Registry Authority Model — Authoritative Sources and Conflict Resolution
authority: PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md; S208 Board A Frozen Principles (P2, P6); governance-guard.js Rule 3
governing_principle: P6 Traceability Everywhere: Every entity shall have exactly one authoritative source. No entity may have two registries claiming authority. When a conflict exists between a generated registry and a raw source file, the raw source file is the ultimate authority.

raw_source.format: JavaScript array of question objects with question_state, CorrectChoice, ExplanationWrong fields
raw_source.note: Raw source files are the ultimate authority for question data. All registries, engines, and delivery mechanisms derive from these files.

generated_registry.format: Markdown table — auto-generated, never hand-edited (governance guard Rule 3 BLOCK)
generated_registry.note: This registry is a DERIVED view. Any discrepancy between the registry and raw files is resolved by re-running the generator from raw files.

other_representations.note: Same content as MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md in CSV format. Not independently authoritative.

consumers: Delivery Mechanism (app.js — reads raw pack files directly for rendering)

conflict_resolution.rule: Raw pack files are the ultimate authority. Generated registry discrepancies are resolved by re-running scripts/build_master_registry.js.
conflict_resolution.example: P1-EC-004: Registry reported 'Unprocessed' but REVISION_HISTORY.md recorded certification in S853. Resolution: raw file question_state wins. Generator re-run confirms. This is a registry staleness issue, not a content issue.

authoritative_source.location: Session registry — created and updated by app.js session management hooks
authoritative_source.note: Sessions are runtime entities. They exist only when the application is active. The session registry is the canonical record of all sessions.

consumers: Student Exposure Index (student_exposure_index.js — currently no operational data)
sessions.validation: S254: 40 sessions, 535 unique QIDs linked, 0 duplicate/phantom/orphan references post-S253 deep-link repair
sessions.conflict_resolution: Session registry is authoritative. If localStorage contains a session not in the registry, it's orphaned and should be migrated or discarded.

authoritative_source.location: Generated by recommendation pipeline during defect analysis
authoritative_source.note: Recommendations link defects to remediation targets. Each REC-ID maps to specific QIDs and defect classes.

recommendations.validation: S254 cross-engine: recommendations linked to 2,382 QIDs across defect classes
recommendations.conflict_resolution: Recommendation registry is authoritative. If a recommendation references a QID not in MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md, the recommendation is stale.

authoritative_source.location: Challenge registry — populated by user challenge submission workflow
authoritative_source.note: Challenges are user-initiated. Each challenge targets a specific QID and may spawn investigations.

consumers: Challenge Workbench (displays challenge context during investigations)
challenges.validation: S254: 35 challenges, 12 triaged (34% — gap), all follow valid state transitions
challenges.conflict_resolution: Challenge registry is authoritative. Current gap: triage at 34% — 23 challenges unattended.

investigations.entity: Formal investigations into identified defects or challenges

authoritative_source.location: Investigation registry — populated by investigation lifecycle hooks
authoritative_source.note: Investigations follow a state machine: OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED/CLOSED. Each investigation links to a challenge, recommendation, session, and certification event.

investigations.validation: S254: 19 investigations, all follow valid state transitions, 0 orphaned references. S256: 8/8 end-to-end investigation chains PASS.
investigations.conflict_resolution: Investigation registry is authoritative. Investigation chains (challenge→defect→recommendation→session→certification) must remain intact.

certification_events.entity: Certification actions — items transitioning to Certified state

authoritative_source.note: The question_state field in raw pack files is the ultimate authority for certification status. All registries and reports must derive from this field.

secondary_sources.note: Records the context of certification decisions — who, when, why. Must be updated with every question_state change (Rule 1 WARN). Does not independently determine certification status.
Session-level snapshots of certification state. Derived from raw files, not independently authoritative.

consumers: Certification Pipeline (reads question_state to determine readiness)
Delivery Mechanism (app.js — ensures only Certified items enter learner pool)
Blueprint Coverage Matrix (counts Certified by domain)
certification_events.validation: Certified count must be verified by direct raw-file grep, not by report consumption (AGENTS.md §5). Cross-reference: P1-EC-004 anomaly confirmed registry-vs-raw discrepancy.

conflict_resolution.rule: Raw file question_state is the ultimate authority. REVISION_HISTORY.md is the authoritative record of the certification decision context. If a generated report disagrees with the raw file, the raw file wins.

authority_chain.description: When multiple sources claim information about the same entity, this chain resolves conflicts

chain.applies_to: Runtime entities created by application operations
Derived views — always reconcilable to priority 1 and 2 sources

automated_check.name: Cross-Engine Consistency Scan
automated_check.description: For each entity type, verify registry claims against raw source files. Flag any divergence.
automated_check.frequency: Per certification wave or per session with >3 agent operations
automated_check.implementation: Cross-reference: (1) MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY question_state vs raw file question_state, (2) session registry QID references vs MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY, (3) recommendation registry QID references vs MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY, (4) challenge registry QID references vs MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY

manual_verification.description: When automated check finds a conflict, direct raw-file line-level inspection resolves it (per AGENTS.md §5). Never trust a report over raw file evidence.

known_anomalies.discrepancy: Registry says 'Unprocessed', REVISION_HISTORY says 'Certified' in S853
known_anomalies.resolution: Raw file question_state is authoritative. Flagged in S254 — pending reconciliation.

governance_guard_integration.rule3: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md is auto-generated from raw pack files. Any attempt to hand-edit it is BLOCKED. This ensures the registry cannot diverge from raw files through human error.
governance_guard_integration.rule1_warn: REVISION_HISTORY.md must be updated with every question_state change. This ensures certification event traceability is maintained.
governance_guard_integration.enforcement: All 6 governance guard rules apply to write operations on all authoritative sources. Registry authority does not exempt any file from governance guard enforcement.
